title: The Station You Mistook for the Whole Sky
evidence_boundary: Attention changes selection and awareness; this does not establish that attention invents the external world.
invitation: When the next belief sounds perfectly clear, could you ask which station is speaking—and what remains audible when you turn the dial?

scenes.text: Your mind does not wait for reality to finish speaking. It tunes the signal early, then calls the prediction perception.
scenes.query: radio dial moving across illuminated frequencies macro motion

scenes.text: Think of attention as a radio dial moving through a crowded midnight spectrum, choosing one station while thousands continue underneath.
scenes.query: analog receiver tuning through crowded spectrum lights

scenes.text: Established research shows attention changes what reaches awareness, but it does not prove that attention invents the outside world.
scenes.query: spotlight crossing laboratory objects while room remains visible

scenes.text: The dial matters because every station arrives with its own rhythm, vocabulary, emotional temperature, and list of details worth noticing.
scenes.query: receiver display changes rhythm waveforms and temperature gauges

scenes.text: Turn toward threat and the receiver amplifies alarms: tightened voices, unfinished messages, doors that close a little too quickly.
scenes.query: closing door and blinking warning receiver in ordinary hallway

scenes.text: Turn toward possibility and different signals strengthen: openings, usable information, patient people, and the small tools already within reach.
scenes.query: open doorway tools on table and people walking in daylight

scenes.text: This is not magic tuning. Bills remain bills, grief remains grief, and other people keep their own frequencies and choices.
scenes.query: unpaid bills beside radio while city continues outside window

scenes.text: The mechanism is simpler: limited attention must select, and selection changes the experienced pattern without granting unlimited control.
scenes.query: one channel selected on mechanical switchboard while others remain active

scenes.text: That is why two people can share one room yet leave carrying different broadcasts, each honest about what reached them.
scenes.query: two people exit same room carrying different portable radios

scenes.text: Neither receiver contains the whole spectrum. Confidence only tells you how clearly your chosen station is arriving, not whether it is complete.
scenes.query: single clear frequency surrounded by many dim active frequencies

scenes.text: The useful move is not forcing a cheerful channel while the building burns. It is noticing who currently holds the dial.
scenes.query: person notices radio dial while fire alarm light flashes safely

scenes.text: Sometimes family handed you the station. Sometimes fear found it. Sometimes repetition wore a groove into the tuning wheel.
scenes.query: worn tuning wheel with grooves beside family photographs

scenes.text: Once a frequency becomes familiar, silence around it feels suspicious, and alternatives may sound weak before they sound possible.
scenes.query: familiar waveform fades while quieter signals emerge

scenes.text: But a preset is not a prison. You can test another station briefly without pretending the old broadcast never mattered.
scenes.query: preset button releases and receiver tunes to second station

scenes.text: Name one signal your current station keeps amplifying. Then name one detail it regularly edits beneath the static.
scenes.query: signal waveform separates from static on oscilloscope

scenes.text: Now feel the chair under you, the floor beneath your feet, and the ordinary room continuing without commentary.
scenes.query: chair floor and quiet ordinary room in morning light

scenes.text: Take one unforced breath. Listen for a sound you did not choose, arriving from outside the argument in your head.
scenes.query: curtain moves as distant street sound enters bright room

scenes.text: When the next belief sounds perfectly clear, could you ask which station is speaking—and what remains audible when you turn the dial?
scenes.query: radio dial turns while open window reveals changing sky
